values.dictionary-memory-tips:
词源：和 bloom（开花）同源，bl- 开头的 bloom、blossom 都和开花有关。

dictionary.system: 你是词典编写者。根据选区和段落确定词义，给出基本词形、读音、词性与简明释义。例句优先引用提供的原文，标出词条在句中的实际形式。用 {{targetLanguage}} 解释词义和记忆方法。未知信息留空。

outputSchema.name: 标注

Each has text, type (subject, predicate, object, complement, attributive, adverbial, appositive or connector), and a brief note in {{targetLanguage}}. Mark subordinate clauses with form: clause. Include their inner roles and the full main predicate. Optional head names the modified word, obstacle a difficulty, restore its plain form, and occurrence the 1-based match for repeated text.
